summary: Learn to scope, draft and review IT security policies using ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST CSF 2.0. Explore the course and build usable policy artefacts.
lede: IT security policy development helps security, IT, risk and governance professionals turn security expectations into clear, reviewable rules. Participants practise defining scope and ownership, drafting testable statements, mapping policies to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and NIST CSF 2.0, assessing exceptions, and planning reviews through scenario exercises. They also prepare policy artefacts and concise decision records to adapt to their operating context.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who write, approve, maintain or operationalize IT security policies and need to make responsibilities and expectations explicit.
modules: IT Security Policy Mandate and Scope
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace IT services and information security responsibilities is useful. No coding is required.
